author: Yffe
content:
Generator plan (#281, single-file minimal fix):

ROOT CAUSE — thermite-lower/src/l1.rs::emit_string_runtime_l1, the bytes_eq twin (l1.rs ~2410): the emitted twin runs the window-bounds guard "if ai_u + n_u > a.data.len() || bi_u + n_u > b.data.len() { return false; }" BEFORE handling the empty window. At (n=0, ai=5 > len=2) this returns false, but the spec body (REQ-18: if n <= 0 { true } else ...) is unconditionally true at n=0 — no index is accessed, so REQ-20 OOB-index exception cannot apply. A verus-PROVEN ens panics its own L1 check in the built binary.

FIX (mirror the spec n<=0 arm before the window guard): emit "if n == 0 { return true; }" as the FIRST statement of the twin (n is u64, so n==0 covers the spec n<=0 total-fn arm — comment states this). The window guard then only fires when at least one index is genuinely accessed, matching REQ-20 SAME-value clause.

- Un-#[ignore] thermite-lower/tests/divergence_bytes_eq_l1_empty_window.rs after green gauntlet.
- AUTHORIZED RIDER (same doc, no test possible): .design/basis/07-strings.md ~line 672 illustrative render_frame sketch offset 8 -> 7 (AC-15 + shipped proven editor pin both say 7).

Gauntlet: build --workspace; clippy -D warnings; fmt; test -p thermite-lower (pin runs green); test -p forge --test editor_runs; full workspace FAILED/error[ count = 0; goldens updated if twin text appears.
Two commits: (1) the fix + doc-sketch rider + goldens; (2) doc-drift pin bumps.
